about: Which word a transcript token adds to the Dictionary (T12.15f): the token's core (no surrounding punctuation, the word matcher's split_punctuation) when it holds a letter, else none. crates/earshot-runtime (vocabulary_tests.rs) runs every case through `vocabulary::dictionary_word`, and packages/ui/src/detail/dictionaryWord.test.ts through the UI's `dictionaryWord`, so the UI cannot offer a word the app would refuse. Every word is invented.
